description: Named messages for CQL constructs outside the TRICC profile (tricc_cql.g4), shared by tricc_oo and tricc-frontend (feature/20261125-expression-languages.md §2). On a syntax error, walk the default-channel tokens in order; the first token matching a construct (in list order) names the error, at that token's line and column. A token matches when its text is in `texts` or its symbolic type is in `types`, and, if `after` is set, the previous default-channel token is an operand end (`operand`: a type in `operand_types` or a text in `operand_texts`) or a number (`number`: type NUMBER). No match: the parser's own message with `codes.syntax`.

constructs.message: A query is not supported in a form; read that data with a prefilled value.
union, intersect and except are not supported in a form; combine the values with or, or with a list {a, b}.
An indexer (x[0]) is not supported in a form; use First(), Last() or a single value.
A retrieve ([Observation]) is not supported in a form; read that data with a prefilled value or a stored-data function such as GetObservationValue().
A quantity with a unit (5 'mg', 3 days) is not supported in a form; write the number and keep the unit in the question.
years between / duration in days of are not supported in a form; use AgeInDays(), AgeInMonths(), AgeInYears() or compare dates.
Member access (x.member, x.f()) is not supported in a form; reference a question as "name" and call a function with the value as its first argument.
